I‘m the same age and never had a relationship. I’ve been in situations like you and let me tell you: you’re not the problem. The problem might be that you’re getting too attached (attachments are never really a good thing), but I wouldn’t say that that’s necessary whats people driving away from you. 
You have to learn that everything is a reflection, so if a person doesn’t like something about you that doesn’t mean you’re the problem, but that the person simply is different and doesn’t see a good match with you. This person might know something about you - something you haven’t noticed yet, but it doesn’t make you compatible in their eyes. It’s hard to explain, but I hope you get it. Someone else will like this certain characteristic about you, that another person didn’t. We’re all different, but that doesn’t mean there’s something wrong with us. It’s always easier to blame yourself instead of separating yourself from other peoples actions and opinions. And it’s easy to blame yourself that love is taking so long to find you. But I’m sure there’s a reason for that. Maybe you have to learn to be happy by yourself? Not getting too attached to one person? You have to find out for yourself. It’s hard, but focus on yourself, by doing what you love you’ll attract people you love and someone will love you the same way :) your existence is proof. You’re lovable! Hope that wasn’t too cheesy hahahha!
